entities.name: Léon Stynen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Léon Stynen was a Belgian architect, urban planner and designer, from Antwerp. Some of his buildings have been categorized as "refined" Brutalist architecture and modern architecture. He has been called one of Belgium's greatest architects of the 20th century.
